AddressBook.label: AddressBook
AddressBook.description: A collection of contacts — a personal or shared address book.

Article.label: Article
Article.description: A long-form authored piece — a blog post, news article, or essay. More structured than Note.

Bookmark.label: Bookmark
Bookmark.description: A saved reference to a web resource — title, URL, optional tags and notes.

Document.label: Document
Document.description: A generic document — a self-contained piece of content with a title, body, and metadata. Spans foaf:Document, schema:CreativeWork, and as:Document.

Event.label: Event
Event.description: A scheduled occurrence with a start (and usually end) time. Aligns with as:Event, schema:Event, and ical:Vevent at the term level.

Note.label: Note
Note.description: A short text post — the fediverse-canonical Note.

Person.label: Person
Person.description: A human person — schema for data typed as urn:solid:Person.

Tracker.label: Tracker
Tracker.description: A container for tracking work items — typically a list of iCalendar Vtodos. The list-level counterpart to single-task Vtodo.

VerifiableCredential.label: VerifiableCredential
VerifiableCredential.description: A W3C Verifiable Credential — a tamper-evident, cryptographically-signed claim made by an issuer about a subject.

Vtodo.label: Vtodo
Vtodo.description: An iCalendar to-do item — a task with status, priority, and optional due dates. RFC 5545 compatible.
